analysis_contract.dynamics_nuisance: inclination uniform in cos(i) over geometrically allowed deprojections; seven beta_z values uniform [-0.8,0.8]; one global template dispersion scale Normal(1,0.022)
analysis_contract.halo_nuisance: Primary pseudo-NFW is concentric/co-aligned, potential flattening q_pot=1-(1-q_density)/2, scale radius fixed to 10 R_eff, f_DM within 2.95 arcsec uniform [0,0.6], q_density uniform [0.3,1].
analysis_contract.interesting_threshold: Candidate must improve joint held-out log predictive density by >=10 over GR+stars+NFW, improve each channel by >=2, pass residual calibration, and exclude g=0 at >=3 posterior standard deviations. Otherwise it is not an empirical survivor.
analysis_contract.lensing_nuisance: external shear magnitude uniform [0,0.08], angle uniform [0,180) degrees, HST sky per connected exposure, fixed empirical correlated-noise scale with one half-normal <=20 percent amplitude nuisance
analysis_contract.likelihood: HST whitened Gaussian pixel likelihood plus full-covariance Gaussian MUSE (v_los,sigma_los) likelihood. The same density parameters and physical state feed both. Source-plane pixels are linear nuisances; no Student-t change after opening.
analysis_contract.optimizer_and_sampler: Differential-evolution MAP with seed 325004 and frozen bounds, followed by emcee 256 walkers, >=20000 post-burn draws per walker, split-Rhat <=1.01 and bulk ESS >=1000 for every reported scalar; failure is invalid, not a score.
analysis_contract.physical_health_is_separate: Even an empirical survivor remains structurally unhealthy unless a nonlinear ghost-free completion, Solar-System screening, and cosmology are supplied. A health failure does not erase an empirical pattern.
analysis_contract.primary_comparator: GR_PLUS_STARS_PLUS_PSEUDONFW_PLUS_BLACK_HOLE with g=0 in the identical density, nuisance, grids, masks and likelihood
retained_countermodels: GR plus constant stellar M/L plus generalized NFW inner slope
GR plus free pseudo-NFW scale radius
GR plus total MGE mass without a baryon/dark partition
split-state diagnostic with a lens-only coefficient, retained solely as a forbidden identifiability control
analysis_contract.stellar_nuisance: Six monotone non-increasing M/L values for seven luminous MGEs with components 1 and 2 tied; log-uniform [0.5,15] solar units subject to monotonicity.
analysis_contract.theory_priors: g uniform [-0.5,0.5], log10(range_kpc) uniform [-1,1.5]; GR is the nested point g=0. Priors are frozen before ESO arrays open.
analysis_contract.within_object_holdout: Before fitting, assign HST mask pixels to five angular sectors by floor(5*angle/2pi); fit sectors 0-3 and predict sector 4. Assign MUSE bins analogously; fit sectors 0-3 and predict sector 4. Rotate the held-out sector once by +2pi/10 as a registered robustness check, not a selection.

cosmology_and_units.distance_algorithm: numerical integral of c/H0 / sqrt(Omega_m*(1+z)^3+Omega_lambda), scipy quad absolute tolerance 1e-10 Mpc and relative tolerance 1e-10
cosmology_and_units.distance_uncertainty: H0 multiplicative nuisance Normal(67.74,0.88) km/s/Mpc; no other cosmological parameter is retuned on ESO

reduction_contract.fail_closed_rule: Any absent extension, invalid checksum, inadequate empirical PSF/LSF/noise support, failed registration, non-positive-semidefinite empirical covariance, or target-free gate failure blocks the ESO score. Do not fill a missing covariance with a diagonal guess.

hst.arc_image: F475W minus the PSF-matched F814W lens model multiplied by a radial colour ratio. The ratio is the median F475W/F814W in 0.25-arcsec annuli excluding 2.20-3.70 arcsec, interpolated with a monotone cubic curve. No post-arc tuning.
hst.astrometric_registration: Start from archive WCS. Fit one six-parameter affine correction using Gaia DR3 positions of at least three unsaturated common point sources; 3-sigma clipping is one pass only. If fewer than three sources or RMS exceeds 0.03 arcsec, block.
hst.dq_selector: matching DQ or context coverage; pixels with nonzero fatal DQ or zero coverage are excluded
hst.lens_center: Joint F814W seven-component MGE centroid outside the frozen 2.20-3.70 arcsec arc-exclusion annulus; both filters share that centre.
hst.lens_light: Fit seven concentric, co-aligned Gaussian components to F814W outside 2.20-3.70 arcsec, convolved with the frozen F814W PSF. The Gaussian scales and axis ratios start at paper Table S1 but all image-fit nuisance values are inferred only inside the frozen contract.
hst.lensing_mask: Finite valid pixels with 1.80 <= elliptical_radius_arcsec <= 4.20, excluding diffraction spikes, saturated pixels, fatal DQ, and foreground objects detected at >=5 connected pixels above 8 robust-sigma outside the arc annulus. The same deterministic mask is used for all models.
hst.noise_and_covariance: Start from WHT. Estimate drizzle correlation from 32x32-pixel blank stamps on a fixed detector-coordinate lattice outside 8 arcsec, rejecting a stamp only for DQ or >5 robust-sigma sources. Require >=32 stamps. Use their median normalized 2D autocorrelation truncated where both axes exceed 5 pixels. Whiten the likelihood with this fixed kernel; failure of a positive-semidefinite circulant embedding blocks scoring.
hst.psf: Empirical, per filter: median stack of at least two isolated unsaturated field stars after local background subtraction and centroid registration. If fewer than two pass deterministic saturation/isolation cuts, acquire an exposure-matched public ePSF/TinyTim product and hash it before continuing; otherwise block.
hst.science_selector: first image HDU with EXTNAME=SCI and positive finite exposure time; ambiguity aborts
hst.source_plane: 80x80 adaptive square pixels, quadratic-gradient regularization, evidence-selected regularization on a frozen 41-point log grid [-8,8]. The source is solved linearly for each nonlinear state and is never shared with the kinematic channel.
hst.weight_selector: matching WHT inverse-variance/weight HDU; absence aborts pixel likelihood
hst.working_grid: F475W celestial WCS and native DRC pixel scale; F814W is flux-conservingly reprojected by exact WCS, Lanczos-3 kernel

missing_public_inputs_before_decode: at least two valid empirical HST PSF stars per filter or hashed exposure-matched public PSFs
three Gaia-registered common point sources or a hash-bound astrometric reference product
successful empirical MUSE LSF and covariance construction under the frozen rules

muse.continuum: Additive Legendre polynomial order 6; one frozen robustness rerun at order 8.
muse.correction_to_prior_plan: The paper reports 0.6-arcsec square spatial pixels, not Voronoi bins. V4 therefore does not invent a Voronoi table.
muse.cube_selectors: Unique DATA and STAT image HDUs with mutually compatible celestial and spectral WCS; ambiguity or missing STAT aborts.
muse.feature_masks: Mask pipeline bad wavelengths and a fixed +/-5 Angstrom observed-frame interval around Mg b in the registered sensitivity run; primary retains Mg b.
muse.kinematics: Fit v_los and sigma_los jointly in every accepted 0.6-arcsec bin after convolving templates to the empirical LSF. Require sigma above the instrumental resolution and optimizer agreement from three fixed initial points.
muse.lsf: Use the wavelength-dependent LSF encoded by the ESO pipeline calibration metadata only if its calibration provenance is present. Otherwise fit a quadratic FWHM(lambda) to at least ten isolated night-sky lines in off-galaxy spaxels; require leave-one-line-out RMS <=0.10 Angstrom. Otherwise block.
muse.noise_and_covariance: Use STAT per spectral sample plus a moving-block wild bootstrap of the whitened spectral residuals: block length 8 samples, 512 replicates, Philox seed SHA256(bin_id)[0:16]. Construct each bin's empirical 2x2 covariance for (v_los,sigma_los). Shared-template systematics are a single global 2.2 percent dispersion-scale nuisance. Do not claim cross-bin independence: estimate a spatial correlation kernel from bootstrap residual maps and require a positive-semidefinite block covariance; otherwise block.
muse.psf: Fit a circular Moffat profile to the paper-identified nearby unsaturated star in the cube white-light collapse. Require 0.47 <= FWHM <= 0.67 arcsec, finite beta > 1.5, and cube-collapse versus selected archive white-light normalized RMS <=0.02 after affine photometric scaling; otherwise block. The published 0.57 arcsec is a predeclared audit benchmark, not a forced fit.
muse.quality: Require >=20 accepted spatial bins, median reduced spectral chi-square in [0.5,2.0], and >=95 percent finite bootstrap fits.
muse.spatial_bins: Non-overlapping 0.6x0.6 arcsec squares aligned north/east and centred on the registered lens centre; retain bins whose centres lie within 4.0 arcsec and have >=80 percent valid input spaxels.
muse.stellar_templates: Primary MILES empirical library and Indo-US G/K stars as the published cross-check. Every template file and license must be revision/hash bound before response extraction; no synthetic template substitution.

reduction_contract.registered_intersection: All HST and MUSE coordinates are ICRS degrees. The model centre and position angle are shared. The lens likelihood uses only the HST mask; the kinematic likelihood uses MUSE bin centres within 4 arcsec. Joint eligibility requires both channels pass independently; no pixel-to-bin response matching is asserted.

shared_physical_state.boundary_conditions: Isolated fields by zero-padding the density by factor two in every dimension, setting the k=0 potential gauge to zero, and cropping the central physical volume. ESO grid must extend to >=10 half-light radii and convergence is checked after doubling the padding and halving the cell size.
shared_physical_state.matter_route: Use only Phi: solve axisymmetric Jeans equations for the MGE tracer with one beta_z per luminous Gaussian, project at the shared inclination, then convolve with the MUSE PSF and integrate over the fixed 0.6-arcsec bins.
shared_physical_state.parameter_status: Target-free injection values frozen for software recovery only. ESO inference may profile the same g and range jointly under the registered priors, but may not introduce any channel-specific coefficient.
shared_physical_state.photon_route: Use only the same state Phi+Psi: integrate its transverse gradient through the full grid, scale with the frozen angular-diameter distances, ray-trace the 80x80 source, then convolve with the HST PSF.
shared_physical_state.scope: A linear weak-field extended-source comparator, not a nonlinear healthy massive-gravity completion.

slacs_confirmation_seal.rule: V4 must never open, deserialize, summarize, score, copy or transform a reserved-confirmation response.
